newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Interest rate cut props up Manila property index.
newsitem.headline: Interest rate cut props up Manila property index.

text.p: The Philippine property sub-index gained 3.99 percent to 1,380.51 points by Friday midsession as the series of interest rate cuts sparked renewed interest in the sector, brokers said.

"The property sector is the most vulnerable to any movement in interest rates. Higher interest rates will eat up margins of developers. Hence, lower rate is good news for them," said David de la Cruz, Amsteel Securities vice-president for marketing.
Filinvest Land Inc was the biggest gainer, rising 7.41 percent to 5.80 pesos.
Heavily-traded property gainers include Empire East Land Holdings Inc and Ayala Land Inc.
Empire East jumped 4.71 percent to 4.45 pesos while Ayala Land gained 2.22 percent to 23 pesos.
Prior to the de facto devaluation of the peso announced last Friday, property stocks were battered by concerns of an impending crash of local property prices due to oversupply.
